thread:
Ava: Heads-up — we need GPU capacity reserved in us-west1 for the new inference cluster bring-up next month. Target initial pool: 32 H100s for staging and 48 A100s for prod canaries. Need runbook for quota + procurement + handoff.

Sam: Ok noted. Which SKUs exactly? H100s are often constrained in us-west1 — might need us-west2 fallback.

Ava: H100-80GB (nvidia-h100-vl) x32, A100-80GB (nvidia-a100) x48. Prefers AZ spread for availability. Goal: have capacity reservations and quota requests submitted this week.

Priya: For the bring-up, do we need dedicated capacity (reserved instances) or a Capacity Reservation / Placement Group style? That affects procurement.

Luca: Procurement note: for cloud committed spend vs on-demand reserved instances, procurement needs the cost estimate and contract length. If we do committed use (1y/3y) there’s an approval path. Otherwise we can request spot/reservation and fallback plan.

Sam: Proposed plan: 1) Submit quota increase & quota reservation requests to cloud (support case + console) for the target SKUs in us-west1. 2) Create Capacity Reservations (AWS EC2, or GCP equivalent) scoped to the cluster's labels. 3) If quota not approved or capacity limited, failover to us-west2 and mark configuration in TF.

Ava: Can you paste the exact steps / sample payload for quota request? I'll own the support ticket and internal approvals.

Sam: Sure — sample GCP quota request body (use as a template):
```
Project: redwood-prod
Region: us-west1
Quotas: 
  - metric: NVIDIA_H100_COUNT
    currentLimit: 0
    requestedLimit: 40
    reason: "Bring-up of inference cluster for Redwood Dedicated; initial staging and canary capacity request; contact: sam@redwood.ai"
```
For AWS we'd open a Support Case with the service code (ec2) and request an ENI/GPU instance quota increase e.g. p5/p4d family.

Priya: Add network constraints to the ticket: we need 2x /27s for node subnets, NAT gateways in each AZ, and 2x internal LB IPs reserved. Also request higher ENI limits per instance type (P4/P5).

Ava: Good catch. Also request accelerated networking flags and MTU expectations.

Luca: Cost estimate (rough, monthly):
- H100 (on-demand) ~ $40/hr -> 32 * 40 * 24 * 30 = $921,600/month (ouch)
- A100 (on-demand) ~ $12/hr -> 48 * 12 * 24 * 30 = $414,720/month
Total on-demand ~ $1.336M/month.
If we do a 1-year committed discount (~45%): ~ $735k/month. Need finance approval.

Ava: We'll plan for a reserved commit pilot of 6–12 months for part of the pool, use autoscaling for burst. Sam, can you draft the TF snippet to create capacity reservation + tags?

Sam: Draft Terraform (snippet):
```hcl
resource "aws_ec2_capacity_reservation" "inference_h100_stage" {
  instance_type = "p5.48xlarge"
  availability_zone = "us-west-1a"
  instance_count = 8
  tags = { "team" = "inference", "env" = "staging" }
}
# repeat across AZs and for A100 pool
```
If using GCP, use `compute_capacity_commitment` and `reservation` resources.

infra-bot: Support ticket CREATED: #S-4321 (cloud-quota-request). Assigned to cloud-support.

Priya: Operational validation checklist for handoff: 
- Nodes boot and join k8s with correct taints/labels (`gpu=true`, `model-pool=h100`)
- Verify kernel drivers and CUDA: `nvidia-smi` shows correct memory and ECC state
- Run perf smoke: 10 concurrent short requests to each node, measure p99 latency < 200ms
- KV cache warmup test and batching SLO verification
- Egress/ingress bandwidth test between region AZs (iperf)
- Confirm monitoring alerts (node GPU util, memory, OOM, temperature)

Ava: Add config validation: check kernel params, hugepages, and docker runtime nvidia-container-runtime config. Also ensure node-local caching service is pre-populated for common model prefixes.

Sam: For quota escalation, if support delays >48h open an exec page and notify infra-ops@redwood.ai. We'll have a parallel plan to spin smaller clusters across two regions (us-west1/us-west2) and route traffic via smart routing.

Luca: Procurement asks: final approval package should include: business justification, expected utilization curve (week1-week12), cost delta for committed vs on-demand, fallback regions, and estimated cost of failed bring-up risk. I'll prepare a template.

Ava: Who will own the final handoff to on-call and SRE for day-1 ops?

Priya: I'll own the on-call runbook and escalation paths. Need Sam to provide the TF outputs (IDs, reservation names) and access tokens for the prom dashboards.

Sam: Will create a PR with TF + sample `capacity_reservation` outputs and add `docs/bringup/validation.md` link. ETA: PR by EOD tomorrow.

infra-bot: Update: Support ticket #S-4321 state=WAITING_FOR_PROVIDER (submitted).

Ava: Great. Action items:
- Ava: collect approvals & coordinate finance (ETA Tue)
- Sam: submit TF PR + support payloads (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- Luca: procurement pricing package (ETA Wed)
- Priya: on-call runbook & validation checklist doc (ETA Wed)

Priya: Small nit — add quota for cloud monitoring agent and log ingestion to quota request to avoid throttling during bring-up.

Sam: Noted. Also adding IAM role limits and service account quotas.

Ava: If anyone hits provider hard limits we pivot to mixed SKUs (smaller A10x / A30x variants) for initial warm-up and then migrate to full H100s. Document the migration steps.

Luca: FYI finance will ask for forecasted QPS and token/sec metrics to justify commit. Ava — can you compile a conservative workload forecast?

Ava: Yes, I'll produce a workload forecast and link to this thread in the approval package.

Sam: Quick troubleshooting snippet if nodes fail driver probe: 
```bash
# verify driver
modinfo nvidia || dmesg | grep -i nvidia
# reinstall driver
sudo apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-535
sudo systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced
```

Priya: Also include a recovery path: detach Capacity Reservation and fallback to spot/ondemand in other AZs + autoscaler config to prefer reserved nodes.

Ava: Thanks all. I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize tickets and approvals. :calendar: :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-01 10:00 UTC — "GPU bring-up sync"

Sam: If quota comes back partial, I'll post exact terraform toggles to flip on multi-region.

Luca: I'll coordinate procurement approvals in parallel and loop in legal for the commit terms.

Priya: I'll start drafting the SRE playbook and include runbook steps to validate cluster health during the first 72 hours.

Ava: Perfect. Closing thread for now; reopen if any blocker. :rocket:
